introduction: Missouri unemployment claims and weekly payment requests use UInteract. Registration is the first step, followed by a claim.
description: Missouri unemployment claims and weekly payment requests use UInteract. Registration is the first step, followed by a claim.

sections.who: DES reviews work history and eligibility. Weekly work, earnings and other conditions affect payment.
sections.get: The agency determines payable benefits. Weekly requests are separate from the initial claim.
sections.docs:
• Social Security number.
  • Employer names, addresses and employment dates for the past 18 months.
  • Weekly gross earnings and optional banking details.
sections.apply:
1. Register

    Use Labor’s filing instructions and UInteract.

  2. File the claim

    Choose Unemployment Claim, then File Unemployment Claim. Save confirmation.

  3. Request payment weekly

    Select Weekly Request for Payment after the week ends and save its confirmation.
sections.after: Read notices and report earnings accurately. Call 800-320-2519 outside local calling areas.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri unemployment filing. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Save both claim and weekly confirmations.
The filing page lists them as optional.
